text:
maria: Heads up — eu-west egress proxy queue cardinality spiked ~5x at 07:12 UTC and batch windows started to saturate. Grafana panel: https://grafana.redwood/d/egress/egress_queue_cardinality (see last 30m). Screenshots in the ticket.
raj: saw it. tail latencies are up and some requests are 502ing. Any relevant logs yet?
maria: Kibana shows a bunch of TLS handshake timeouts and proxy 502s around the same time. Node conntrack counts jumped to the limit. Sample log line: `tcp: TLS handshake failed: timeout`.
autoscale-bot: autoscaler: scaled pool-eu-west-gpu up +2 at 07:18 (policy: queue_depth > 1200 for 2m).
olivia: NAT conntrack exhaustion matches previous incidents — new outgoing connections stall and the proxy starts queuing requests, which then blows up batch windows. We saw identical behaviour last quarter.
jing: can we flip a small-batch policy for eu-west temporarily? Lowering max_batch_size should reduce headroom sensitivity and cut tail latency while we fix conntrack.
raj: small-batch helps but increases cost and GPU utilization. Another angle: add a debounce to the queue-saturation alert and short-circuit large-batches when queue latency > X.
maria: proposed immediate actions:
  1) bump conntrack on nodes (short term)
  2) enable small-batch policy for eu-west for 20m
  3) add a 90s debounce to queue_saturation alert for region eu-west
  4) route a small % of traffic to dedicated eu cluster if things worsen
  I opened TKT-3421 and attached a couple of dashboards.
olivia: PromQL I used to reproduce the behaviour (approx):
```
sum by(region) (increase(proxy_request_queue_length[3m]))
/ sum by(region) (machine_capacity_gpu)
```
Not perfect but shows the region-level burst compared to capacity.
raj: manual mitigation plan: I'll SSH to pool-eu-west nodes and bump sysctl: `sysctl -w net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_max=262144` then reload kube-proxy if conntrack table still full. Also will watch `conntrack -S`.
maria: i'm applying the conntrack bump on three nodes now, will monitor.
autoscale-bot: autoscaler: small-batch-policy apply attempt -> failed (config validation error). See logs: validation error on policy json (missing max_concurrency field).
raj: fixing policy JSON now and reapplying with `max_concurrency: 64`.
raj: small-batch policy applied successfully to eu-west (pool-eu-west-gpu). Watching queue depth and headroom.
maria: after conntrack bump + small-batch, queue_cardinality and batch saturation are returning to baseline. Tail p99 down from 1.8s -> 320ms in the last 20m.
olivia: follow-ups: (a) permanent increase to NAT gateway conntrack or move to managed NAT with autoscaling, (b) add a circuit-breaker on proxy for idle TLS handshakes, (c) add 95/99 tail lines to the headroom dashboard and a per-region debounce knob.
jing: also add an alert that fires when `proxy_queue_growth_rate` > 50% AND `conntrack_used` > 90% for > 90s. That caught this earlier than pure queue saturation.
maria: closing loop: metrics stabilized, cost impact minimal so far. TKT-3421 updated with RCA and owner=olivia. Will open a follow-up PR to dashboards to add the new panels/alerts.
raj: thanks all — nice quick triage. Marking thread resolved for now. :thumbsup:
